result: The α-β condition on the individual losses admits saddle points and local minima (PL does not), yet still gives SGD, SPSmax and NGN an O(K−1/2) rate up to a ball of size O(βσ²int); the authors check it along training runs of real networks.
result_plain: A landscape condition that allows saddles and gives SGD-type methods convergence up to a neighbourhood, checked empirically on deep nets.
